title: Acquirer: Kronos Inc; Target: Australian Timewise Systems Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Kronos Incorporated ("Kronos") is proposing to acquire all of the issued shares in Australian Timewise Systems Pty Ltd ("ATS").
body_sections.Market definition: Employee time management, productivity and attendance software.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission noted that its concentration thresholds were not crossed. In addition, imports hold more than 10% of the market and customers appear to have a degree of countervailing power.
